why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items. Item 1: Check 3 requires every exported function, "this must include capitalize, slugify, truncate and padLeft", to have a section. It also notes that "a PR that only adds padLeft fails this check", so a README with only a padLeft section does not pass. Item 2: no check is stricter than its expect line. Check 1 tests left padding with the given fill or a default space, up to width. Check 2 tests that s comes back unchanged. Neither checks the parameter count or limits fill to one character, and the advisory says "multi-character fill behaviour is not specified". Check 3 asks for a section "whose heading names that function", which is a fair reading of "a section for" a function and not a fixed layout. The '## name(...)' format appears only in the builder brief, as advice, and is not a PASS/FAIL condition. Check 4 matches its line.
